verdict.line: You lose trades before level 6 to K'Sante's Q poke and W stun/knockback, but the matchup swings back to you (53% over 1091 games) once your Fury combo and Eclipse into Black Cleaver come online.

brief.thesis: K'Sante holds the lane advantage and the solo-kill advantage because Q (Ntofo Strikes) is a 3.5s-cooldown poke that stacks toward a pulling shockwave, and W (Path Maker) threatens a charge-up stun/knockback that Renekton has no way to interrupt at range. Renekton's answer isn't out-trading him level-for-level — it's stacking Fury past 50 so W (Ruthless Predator) triple-slashes through his E shield and E (Slice and Dice) hits empowered, then closing the gap through Eclipse and Black Cleaver. The 53% head-to-head win rate over 1091 games says this works; it just doesn't work in the first three levels.

theirWindow.what: The second Q stack fires a shockwave that pulls you in, setting up a follow-up auto and potentially his W charge. Back off after his first Q connects instead of trading through the second.

yourWindow.when: Your Fury is above 50 with E up
yourWindow.what: Empowered E (Slice and Dice) dashes in with bonus damage and Armor shred, then W (Ruthless Predator) triple-slashes for 1.5s of stun and destroys his E shield outright. Commit the full combo here, not piecemeal.

powerCurve.note: W charge-stun and E shield punish all-ins
Dominus health and Fury generation close gap
Black Cleaver/Death's Dance win extended fights

start.why: 53.5% win rate over 955 games and the clear majority pick (76.4%) — the extra sustain matters against a Q that pokes on a 3.5s cooldown.

boots.why: 54.1% win rate over 826 games and 71.9% pick rate; cuts down the auto-attack chip damage from his Q-into-auto pattern and any All Out auto resets.

core.why: Empowered-auto shield synergizes with the burst window right after your W stun lands.
Armor shred stacks with your empowered E's own Armor reduction, letting your combo actually kill through his tank stats.
Highest-winrate finisher on this path (54% over 87 games) — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his All Out burst window.

situational.when: he is landing his All Out combo on you consistently and you need the bonus health plus tenacity to survive it
the game goes long and you want the ability haste to loop W and E faster in extended skirmishes
you need the mobility to actually stick a slash on him instead of getting kited by his E dashes

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-played page on this matchup (42.2% pick, 52.2% win rate); the stacking adaptive force/healing rewards drawn-out trades once your Fury combo is online.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the majority pick (70.8%) and posts a 52.1% win rate; the extra kill pressure matters once your level 3+ combo and 50-Fury threshold start landing. Flash+Teleport (52.7% win rate, 28.3% pick) is the better call if you're getting shoved and need to reset waves instead of standing in Q range.

playing.title: Farm with Q, don't trade with it
playing.detail: Use Q (Cull the Meek) to last-hit and build Fury rather than face-checking his Q poke every wave. You want to be at 50+ Fury before you commit to anything.

playing.title: Punish after his Q whiffs
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes is only 3.5s cooldown but that's still a real window — if he misses it or uses it to farm, walk up for a free Q/auto trade before it's back.

playing.title: Never eat his second Q stack
playing.detail: The second hit of Ntofo Strikes fires a shockwave that pulls you in and sets up his follow-up. Step out of range once you see the first stack land.

playing.title: Save W to break his shield
playing.detail: At 50+ Fury, W (Ruthless Predator) destroys damage shields on hit. Bait his E shield first, then W through it instead of wasting the triple-slash on an unshielded trade.

playing.title: Respect his W charge-up
playing.detail: Path Maker has a visible charge before the dash lands a knockback and stun. Don't stand in a straight line near a wall or your turret while he's charging it.

playing.title: Contest fights on your ult timer
playing.detail: Dominus grants bonus health and generates Fury while active, which is exactly what you need to survive his All Out burst. Look for skirmishes when your R is up rather than waiting for him to force one.

playing.title: Play for the Eclipse spike
playing.detail: Your trades get dramatically better once Eclipse is complete around a full clear or two after level 9 — hold extended trades until you have it rather than all-inning on first-item Doran's alone.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and lane-phase tactics are my own read of the two kits.
